Zubat.Ultra Sun: It has no eyeballs, so it can't see. It checks its surroundings via the ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.
Zubat.White: It checks its surroundings and location using reflections of the ultrasonic waves from its mouth.
Zubat.White 2: It does not need eyes, because it emits ultrasonic waves to check its surroundings while it flies.
Zubat.X: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from it mouth.
Zubat.Y: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on its ultrasonic cries for echolocation to flit about in darkness.
Zubat.Yellow: Emits ultrasonic cries while it flies. They act as a sonar used to check for objects in its way.
